name: Repository Hub
tagline: Lists all our GitHub projects in one place, with plain-language notes, so you can find and open a tool.
summary: The repository hub is a web page on GitHub Pages for everyone in the Cobblestone Learning organisation. Sign in with your own GitHub account to see every project. Managers also get a link to the management page.
features: Browse projects by the job they do, or follow a learner's journey from sign-in to report.
See which projects work with each platform, and which run on each site.
Explore every project as a building in the **City**, or as a stone on the **Map**.
Open a project page with its pictures, step-by-step guides, staff notes and demo.
Switch between **Organisation** and **Mine** once you have signed in.
